featured.content: La controversia salió a la luz el 16 de noviembre, cuando se difundió un audio atribuido a la diputada Claudia Bilbao, en el que reclama a Quiroga por no haber contratado a personas que habría recomendado. El caso de presunto cuoteo político en la Agencia de Infraestructura en Salud y Equipamiento Médico (AISEM) se amplió con denuncias penales, audios y conversaciones de WhatsApp difundidos públicamente, además de acusaciones cruzadas entre diputados oficialistas del Partido Demócrata Cristiano (PDC) y la exdirectora de la entidad, Daniela Quiroga. Las presuntas presiones y el inicio del caso La controversia salió a la luz el 16 de noviembre, cuando se difundió un audio atribuido a la diputada Claudia Bilbao, en el que reclama a Quiroga por no haber contratado a personas que habría recomendado. La legisladora reconoció la conversación, pero sostuvo que la grabación estaba recortada y negó haber enviado listas de postulantes. El 17 de noviembre se conoció una segunda grabación, esta vez atribuida al diputado Alejandro Medinaceli. En ella cuestiona que dos designaciones no se hubieran concretado como, según señala, habían instruido. «¿Daniela, quieres seguir trabajando o no? No entiendo. Porque nos estás generando problemas», se escucha decir al legislador. Quiroga explicó posteriormente que las presuntas presiones comenzaron con recomendaciones de hojas de vida, pero se intensificaron durante los últimos tres o cuatro meses de los siete que permaneció al frente de la institución. Según su testimonio, las solicitudes se transformaron en amenazas cuando se negaba a contratar a personas que no cumplían los perfiles profesionales. Quiroga identifica un “clan” En entrevista con ERBOL, la exdirectora identificó a Claudia Bilbao, Alejandro Medinaceli y Óscar García como integrantes de un supuesto grupo que actuaba coordinadamente para gestionar contrataciones. «Los tres definían, por así decirlo, a quién me enviaban (…) Era como un clan», afirmó. Quiroga aseguró que recibió aproximadamente 50 currículums remitidos por legisladores y estimó que alrededor de 40 personas llegaron a incorporarse a la AISEM. En otra entrevista, ante ANF, habló de al menos 100 hojas de vida y aclaró que algunas contrataciones se concretaron cuando los postulantes cumplían los requisitos establecidos. Atribuyó a Bilbao el envío de la mayor cantidad de currículums, aproximadamente 30, mediante mensajes de WhatsApp y documentos físicos. También señaló que la diputada indicaba los cargos que debían ocupar los postulantes. Como ejemplo, mencionó el caso de una persona propuesta para una jefatura de auditoría que no había concluido la carrera universitaria. Sobre Medinaceli, afirmó que le reclamaba por las personas que no eran incorporadas y que incluso la convocaba a reuniones en su oficina del piso 19 de la Casa Grande del Pueblo. También mencionó a Alejandro Aparicio como un intermediario que inicialmente llevaba las hojas de vida de los legisladores. La exdirectora relató que las negativas a determinadas contrataciones derivaron en amenazas. «Ya había un hostigamiento: si no pones, te vas. O sea, tienes que ponerlo porque si no te vamos a sacar», manifestó. También lamentó no haber denunciado antes las situaciones que, según dijo, llegó a normalizar durante su gestión. Las respuestas de los diputados Bilbao reconoció que conversó con Quiroga, pero sostuvo que la grabación difundida omitió partes en las que, según su versión, reclamaba por la permanencia de funcionarios del Movimiento Al Socialismo (MAS). featured.title_zh: 神圣的盛宴让饕餮之徒望洋兴叹
featured.content: It’s feasting season. Thanksgiving. Advent. New Year’s. But for Americans in particular, is there such a thing as a non -feasting season? Our society has a bizarre love-hate relationship with food, pulling the plate toward us with one hand while pushing it away with the other. On the one hand, about 40 percent of adults are clinically obese; on the other, more than one in eight adults rely on GLP-1 to suppress their appetite. We want food and we want to want food less. We struggle to break free from the clutches of Big Food, so we look to Big Pharma for help. Happy Thanksgiving? What’s the remedy for this gastronomic schizophrenia? As counterintuitive as it sounds, godly feasting provides an antidote to foolish gluttony. Feasting vs. Feeding The Bible has a lot to say about food, not just in isolated verses but in plot points central to the arc of Scripture. Many of the most egregious sins centered on food. For instance, the first sin involved rebellious eating, looking to something forbidden in search of goodness (Genesis 3:6). After the exodus, Israel grumbled about their desire for Pharaoh’s pots of meat (Exodus 16:3). Then, when the Lord provided manna in the wilderness, Israel reenacted the sin of Eve when they gathered food on the Sabbath against God’s command (Exodus 16:27–30). But the Bible also commends feasting, both spiritual and physical. Jesus offers himself as the bread of life, given for the nourishment of the saints in exile (John 6:35). And the church looks forward to a meal at the consummation of history, the marriage feast of the Lamb (Revelation 19:9). Between the resurrection and return of the Lamb, we weekly feast on his body and blood, anchoring our minds on what Christ has done and what Christ will do (1 Corinthians 11:23–26). Godly feasting leans into our place in between the times by remembering with gratitude what was and anticipating with joy what will be. All the blessed feasts in the Scriptures are communal celebrations . Something extraordinary has happened; raise a glass to the King! We shouldn’t eat what we regularly eat today; instead, “bring the fattened calf and kill it, and let us eat and celebrate. For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found!” (Luke 15:23–24). We break from feeding ourselves (simply giving our body what it needs) in order to feast (eating and drinking more than we need) as a blessed means of joyously celebrating the work of God in history. But most Christians rarely, if ever, truly feast with mindful gratitude. We just overeat. Spiritual Malnutrition “A companion of gluttons shames his father” (Proverbs 28:7). The glutton does not feast; his god is his belly. He looks for deliverance in his next snack, his next meal, his next drink. He does not fully grasp that man does not live by bread alone. He is not marked by gratitude. The emptiness in his soul, the purposelessness of his life, and the joylessness of his ease have taken root as a spiritual disease. “A glutton is one who raids the icebox for a cure for spiritual malnutrition,” Frederick Buechner observed ( Wishful Thinking , 35). Americans, overall, remain locked in a permanent state of pseudo-feasting. Our culture combines industrial-grade, highly addictive food products and dopamine-seeking, nihilistic joylessness. We mindlessly munch. Often, we hardly even taste or enjoy our food. (A 2026 JAMA study revealed 69 percent of kids and 78 percent of adults use screens while eating.) This is an often-undiscussed problem within the church. I don’t know any Christians who intend to be gluttonous. But I know many, myself included, who have at times felt buried by the shame that follows an episode or season marked by a lack of self-control. We know we cannot make peace with sin, but we aren’t sure what this specific path of repentance looks like. featured.title_zh: 您的休息习惯揭示了您的内心
featured.content: “Hey, honey, you’re not going to be able to sleep tonight if you don’t start shutting things down soon!” After 36 years of marriage, my husband knows me well. He’s absolutely right, but I still sometimes want to keep pushing until bedtime. The way of wisdom is to stop consciously, set the work aside, and engage in the repetitive, mundane wind-down of the day. The work will still be there tomorrow, and I can trust God for new mercies to finish when morning comes (Lamentations 3:22–23). Our habits of rest reveal what we trust. While our need for sleep, recreation, and downtime weighs on our very physical, very finite bodies, we often resist submitting to our limitations. Substituting entertainment for true rest, we become passive consumers of endlessly streaming content that devours our time. Paradoxically, we crave rest and engage in ceaseless striving after things we hope will satisfy the desires of our heart. This is an ongoing battle for me, and I know I’m not alone. Our society values activity and busyness. We spend our hours and days going and doing, always with one eye on the clock. We reward tireless resilience with job promotions and earnest admiration. In our fervor for achievement, we may forget that rest is necessary for quality work to continue — and that rest can teach our hearts to trust God. Rest Reveals the Heart Psalm 127:1–2 is a reminder for our caffeinated and sleep-deprived souls that progress depends not solely on the work of our own hands but on God’s gracious provision: Unless the L ORD builds the house, those who build it labor in vain. Unless the L ORD watches over the city, the watchman stays awake in vain. It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest, eating the bread of anxious toil; for he gives to his beloved sleep. Note that the psalmist illustrates a right and a wrong way to work. He makes three important points for the restless. 1. The Lord builds the house. God builds the ministry, the family, and the career. We work in cooperation with the Lord, and he watches over us and our work. The point is not that we shouldn’t work heartily at whatever we do (Colossians 3:23). Rather, our security is found in God, not in our efforts. Knowing our frame, remembering that we are dust, God commands us to observe regular patterns of rest, not only for our physical health but also as an acknowledgment of our dependence upon him (Psalm 103:14). 2. The Lord watches over the city. Whether we’re closing our eyes or closing our laptop and office door at the end of the day, when we leave the results of our work in God’s hands, we demonstrate trust in him. “He who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep,” the psalmist writes (Psalm 121:4). God is your keeper, too. Entrusting our work to the Lord prevents it from becoming an idol. In our glad contemplation of work well done, we remember that he is both giver and gift. Our work is evidence of his power and goodness. 3. The Lord gives sleep to his beloved. Anyone who has spent a night sleepless from worry knows our bodies are not designed to run on anxious adrenaline. Insomnia has many causes and may not indicate a spiritual problem, but God often uses physical symptoms to reveal our spiritual condition. A steady diet of “the bread of anxious toil” (Psalm 127:2) starves us of what we need most: the ability to rest in God. When we rest, we accept our God-given limits. We hand the controls over to him. We lay aside our disordered loves, and we choose to believe the Father’s delight in Christ is also for us, his treasured children: “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased” (Matthew 3:17). Because it can feel entirely unnatural, we may need to approach rest as a learned behavior, a habit of holiness, a spiritual discipline that we “put on” in the same way Paul exhorted the Colossians to clothe themselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience (Colossians 3:12). Such discipline is worth the effort; when we rest, we proclaim

featured.title: Don’t Be Afraid of the Alien Question
featured.summary: ‘Faith in Space’ shows that many Americans throughout history have already taken the question of extraterrestrial life seriously, but they’ve done so from outside an orthodox Christian framework.

featured.title_zh: 不要害怕外星人的问题
featured.content: Have you ever wondered whether other worlds exist, and, if they do, whether they’re filled with intelligent life? If so, you’ve tapped into a deeply human instinct. Americans have long looked up at the night sky and asked that question. For Christians, though, the answers can feel unnerving. We already believe in nonhuman intelligence. We call them angels and demons. But aliens would be something else—material, embodied, literally otherworldly . In 2016, NASA started a conversation among religious scholars at the Center of Theological Inquiry in Princeton about what the existence of extraterrestrial life would mean for religion. Paul Gutjahr, Ruth N. Halls professor of English at Indiana University, has been wrestling with that question for years. Faith in Space: American Religious Belief in Extraterrestrial Life is his considered answer. He thinks we need to look back at existing “extraterrestrial cosmologies” in American religions rather than merely pondering future possibilities (7). Faith in Space is ultimately a history of what happens when religious communities take extraterrestrial life seriously. Many minority religions have, and it has shaped their cosmology and even their soteriology. But for many evangelical Christians, Gutjahr’s history raises a more uncomfortable question: What happens when we don’t take seriously the possibility of extraterrestrial life? Alien Religion Early Americans didn’t need much help imagining inhabited worlds. According to Gutjahr, many Americans “believed there to be life elsewhere in the universe” (19). By the end of the 19th century, “every stratum of American society had been exposed” to this belief (43). For example, Emanuel Swedenborg taught that the universe is populated with humans bearing God’s image and claimed to have conversed with them. His American followers never numbered more than a few thousand, and yet his ideas traveled across the young nation; Helen Keller held them, as did John Chapman (a.k.a. Johnny Appleseed). What happens when we don’t take seriously the possibility of extraterrestrial life? Andrew Jackson Davis, the father of American Spiritualism, was similarly inspired, convinced that “if life is to be found on other planets, it is human life.” He arranged extraterrestrial humans in “a progression of degrees that move from less to more spiritual” (64). Then Joseph Smith took things further. Latter-day Saints (Mormons) took an “aggressive extraterrestrial cosmological stance,” linking all worlds under one governing structure (79). God created many inhabited worlds arranged in “a hierarchy where some worlds rule over others” (89). Among these many worlds, Earth holds the least desirable title of “the most wicked, and thus most in need of a savior” (86). God himself is an enfleshed exalted man dwelling on a planet near the star Kolob. I’d add that the Salt Lake Temple bears the Big Dipper, and early Latter-day Saint temple iconography is thick with suns, moons, and stars. Next came the founder of Seventh-day Adventism, Ellen G. White. Where William Miller’s followers read comets and meteor showers as signs of Christ’s return, White gave Seventh-day Adventists “a far more complex understanding of their relationship with the stars” (124). Ours “was the only wicked world” (125). White distinguished strongly between the righteous and unrighteous worlds, and put Earth on the wrong side of that distinction. By the 20th century, the heavens were packed and theories about the heavens were part of salvation. Then comes Helena Blavatsky (Theosophy), L. Ron Hubbard (Scientology), Wallace Fard Muhammad and Louis Farrakhan (Nation of Islam), Malachi Z. York (Nuwaubian Nation), Ashtar Command, and Heaven’s Gate. All these figures or groups saw extraterrestrial life as part of the human story, whether for our good or our ill, or both. featured.summary_zh: 我们都需要对上帝对所有众生和事件的主权统治有更大的敏感性。亚历山大·卡森（ Alexander Carson ）的研究《圣经所体现的天意的历史》（ The History of Providence as Manifested in Scripture ）可以帮助我们培养这种敏感性。以下是耶利米书第14章中他对犹大饥荒主题的评论：由于饥荒的存在， […]犹大的饥荒后：上帝的普罗维登斯显示首先出现在美国真理的旗帜上。
featured.title_zh: 犹大饥荒：神的普罗维登斯显现
featured.content: We all need a greater sensitivity to God’s sovereign rule over all beings and events. Alexander Carson’s study, The History of Providence as Manifested in Scripture can help train us in such sensitivity. Here are his comments on the subject of famine in Judah from Jeremiah 14: FOR the existence of plenty as of famine, the wisdom of this world looks no higher than to what are called second causes. God, it is considered, is no farther concerned in these matters than as the author of certain general laws. He has set the machine a-going, and it continues to work by its own construction, without any regulation of a superintending hand. Climate, soil, cultivation, need, it is confessed, favourable seasons, but any divine direction of weather is supposed to be unnecessary. Timely rain—or the want of it, is a matter below the attention of the Ruler of the world. The blight and the mildew, the wet and the caterpillar, are enemies with which the farmer is to struggle; but they are never considered as armies of devastation sent into the fields by a righteous Providence. The history of the Old Testament gives us a key to Providence in the production of famine or of plenty. God regulates the supplies of the children of men as exactly as if each individual of the human race had his rations assigned him by the angels of heaven every rising sun: ‘The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth. Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up. And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty: they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads. Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the ploughmen were ashamed, they covered their heads. Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass. And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass. O Lord, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.’—Jer. 14:1–7. As in creation and in Providence, so in redemption, God hides himself in the midst of a blaze of light. In all his works he reveals himself, yet the enmity of the human heart will not allow men to see him. And what is most strange, the savage sees a divine hand in the works of Providence; it is unseen and denied by philosophical wisdom. The illiterate peasant hears God in his voice of thunder and storms, and acknowledges divine wrath in pestilence, sword, and famine. But the philosopher perceives nothing in all these but the course of nature. The wisdom of man makes itself ignorant of what the very beasts seem to feel. featured.content_zh: 我们都需要更加关注上帝对所有生命和事件的主权统治。 Alexander Carson的研究, 《普罗维登斯的历史》, 以下是他从耶利米14号对犹大饥荒主题的评论: 对于饥荒时存在的富足,这个世界的智慧看起来并不比所谓的"第二原因"更高. 据认为,与某些一般法律的制定者相比,上帝在这些事务上没有更多的关切。 他把机器设为正常运行,它继续按自己的构造运作,没有任何管制的上司手. 气候,土壤,种植,需要,是承认的,有利的季节,但是任何神圣的天气方向都应该是不必要的. 及时降雨——或者说,这是世界统治者不关心的问题。 荒凉和温和的、湿润的和毛毛的,是农民要与之斗争的敌人;但他们从未被视为正义的普罗维登斯派入田地的毁灭军队。 "旧约"的历史为我们提供了普罗维登斯产生饥荒或富饶的关键. 真主为世人的给养而加以管理,犹如每个人的给养,每逢太阳升起,就奉天天神所赐给每个人一样。 犹大哀悼而其中的城门枯萎;他们已变成黑色的;耶路撒冷的呼声已升起。 其贵人又将小人送入水中去:来入坑中去,又无取出水来;又以器物入空而回;自惭而自愧,自蒙而出. 因为地是分明的,因为地上没有下雨,犁地人感到羞愧,就把头盖了起来. 有之,后人又以地为牛,而弃之,因有草而去. 野驴们的确站在高处,他们像龙一样把风扑倒;他们的眼睛确实衰败了,因为没有草. 主啊!我们的罪过虽能证明我们的罪过,但求你为你的名字而行之;我们的背负是多的;我们确已犯罪了。 与创造和普罗维登斯一样,在救赎中,上帝将自己隐藏在一束光芒中. 在他的所有作品中,他都暴露了自己,然而人心的敌意却不允许人见到他. 最奇怪的是,野蛮人看到普罗维登斯的作品中有神之手;它是看不见的,被哲学智慧所否定. 文盲农民在雷和风暴中听到上帝的声音,在瘟疫、剑和饥荒中承认神圣的愤怒。 但是哲学家在所有这些事物中,除了自然的走向,什么也看不出来. 人类的智慧使自己对野兽的感受一无所知. 更多信息:卡森所著"普罗维登斯的历史"(The History of Providence As Expressed in Books by Carson, Alexander price from: $ 13.50 学习更多选择选项描述) 基督教徒最感兴趣的话题。 以天经为阅读者,并举出真主赐予信士们的慰藉。 264pp. Featured Photo(当作品在社交媒体上分享时可以看见),

featured.title_zh: 让苦涩的东西变甜的上帝
featured.content: The Israelites had just walked between the walls of the water of the Red Sea and watched as the Lord washed away the whole Egyptian army. They sang a song of triumph on the far shore of the sea, rejoicing in the fear that had fallen on the surrounding nations (Ex. 15:14-16) and looking forward to taking possession of the Promised Land in the near future (Ex. 15:17). But within three days they raised a very different kind of sound—a chorus of grumbling against Moses because there was no water to drink at Marah (Ex. 15:22-26). I wonder what they expected would happen after the Red Sea. A straight, unhindered journey to the land flowing with milk and honey? Instead the first thing the Lord does is to lead his people to the undrinkable water of Marah. There is no question that the Lord is the one who led them there—it is easy enough to take a wrong turn when you are following Google Maps, but not when you are following a towering pillar of cloud or fire! So why did God lead Israel to Marah? Is it because he is sadistic and cruel and takes delight in watching his people suffer dehydration and fear? Is it because he is really bad at geography? Of course not! In fact we’re told why he brought Israel to Marah in Ex. 15:25: There the Lord tested them. In fact, the whole wilderness is a place of testing. That’s the significance of the wilderness—it’s a hard place. Deuteronomy 8:15 calls it ‘the vast and dreadful wilderness, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions.’ God is training his infant son to trust him—and training is always painful. There are no short cuts, whether in the physical training of our bodies to make them stronger and faster, or in the mental training of our minds to increase our knowledge and understanding, or in the spiritual training of our souls to grow in godliness. Learning to trust God is not something we can do lounging on the sofa. It means being put into situations that are stressful, confusing, messy and complicated, when we don’t understand what is going on or see any answers. Anyone can trust God when things are easy; the real test is if you will trust God when things are tough. Israel’s failure Marah was Israel’s first test and they failed. They have been travelling for three days and haven’t found any water. Supplies are running low. Perhaps as they saw the waters of Marah in the distance they finished up their last reserves: ‘It’ll be OK—we can refill very soon!’ Imagine the relief and joy as the first to reach Marah fall down and scoop the water to their mouths. And imagine them spitting it out as they discover it is foul and undrinkable. They’re not just disappointed—they’re horrified . Panic seizes them. ‘What shall we drink?’ (v. 24) This is not like someone in a restaurant complaining that their steak is a bit on the tough side or that the soup is a tad cold. They are exhausted and dehydrated and they can’t see any way of getting water. Suddenly life is hanging by a thread. There is nothing unreasonable about their concern. That is not why they fail the test. They fail the test because of their attitude. They grumble: the word means ‘hostile complaining, verbal attacks of dissatisfied people.’ Why do they grumble? There are at least two reasons: Faithlessness . They do not trust God. They don’t trust his power (that he can take care of them) or his goodness (that he wants to take care of them). They should have gone to the Lord with their needs, humbly asking him to provide what they needed. And this lack of faith was due to… Forgetfulness . This is the diagnosis of Psalm 78:40ff: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the desert! … They did not remember his power or the day when he redeemed them from the foe , 43 when he performed his signs in Egypt and his marvels in the fields of Zoan. The people had such short memories! It has only been three days since they walked through the Red Sea! It has been just a few weeks since they witn

(v.24) 这不像餐馆里有人抱怨 他们的牛排有点硬 或者汤有点冷 他们已经精疲力竭并脱水, 突然间,生命被一丝一缕地挂起 他们的关切没有什么不合理的。 这并不是他们失败的原因。 他们因为态度而未能通过测试. 他们抱怨道:这个词的意思是“敌意抱怨, 他们为什么抱怨? 至少有两个原因:失信。 他们不相信上帝。 他们不相信他的能力(他能照顾他们)或善良(他想照顾他们), 他们应该带着自己的需要去主那里,谦卑地要求他提供他们需要的东西. 缺乏信心是因为... 这就是对"诗经"78:40ff的诊断:他们在荒野中频繁地反抗他,在沙漠中为他悲伤!...... 他们不记得他的威力,也不记得他从敌人手中赎回他们的那一天,43岁时他在埃及行过他的迹象,他在Zoan地上行过他的奇事。 人们记忆很短! 他们从红海走过才三天! 几周前他们才开始

featured.title: When Morningness Is Confused with Godliness
featured.summary: Could it be possible that our idealizing of morning quiet times is more cultural than biblical?
featured.summary_zh: 我们对早晨安静时间的理想化是否比圣经更具文化性？
featured.title_zh: 当早晨与虔诚混淆时
featured.content: “Do your quiet time with God every morning.” “Give God your first hours (your best hours!) of the day.” “Rise early for Scripture and prayer; it sets the tone for the rest of your day!” From pulpits to podcasts, I’ve heard these sentiments often in Christian circles. The instructions aren’t just to spend alone time with God but to specifically do so as the very first act of your day. For many, the “morning quiet time” has become a measuring rod of how well you’re doing in your relationship with God. Actor Mark Wahlberg once went viral on Instagram for a screenshot of his morning routine : waking up at 2:30 a.m., praying at 2:45, and completing his first workout before 5:30. This is one of many examples of how early rising has become associated with aspirational godliness. But is it really more virtuous to be a morning person than a night owl? What If You Have to Sleep In? Behind the modern mindset of hyperidealized mornings is the assumption that being a “morning person” is a virtue in and of itself—a gritty choice toward wellness and productivity within everyone’s power. The implication is that if you’re disciplined and wise, you’ll set the alarm clock and start the day early; you’ll make it happen. If you’re slothful or foolish, you won’t. Extenuating circumstances are just excuses. For many, the ‘morning quiet time’ has become a measuring rod of how well you’re doing in your relationship with God. But what would this mean for nurses whose work begins and ends when it’s dark outside? What about parents with newborns, whose babies’ demands don’t abide by our ideal rhythms? How about Christians who are naturally night owls: most alert, focused, and productive at night? Should these folks just suck it up and aspire to get up earlier in spite of their circumstances? Or could it be possible that our idealizing of morning quiet times is more cultural than biblical? God Loves Early Risers At first glance, it might seem that God’s Word does value our mornings most. Pastor David Mathis wrote an insightful article summarizing the abundance of instances in Scripture in which God’s people (including Christ himself!) either rose early to good effect or were directed by God to do so. Consider the Psalms: In Psalm 5:3, David says, “O LORD, in the morning you hear my voice.” In Psalm 88:13, the Sons of Korah sing, “In the morning my prayer comes before you.” In Psalm 90:14, Moses prays to God, “Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.” God clearly meets with his people in the morning. Case closed? Not quite. When you consult the whole counsel of Scripture, it becomes clear that God emphasizes meditating on his Word, singing his praises, and praying to his name just as much in the night as in the morning. Nocturnal Worship Let’s explore some nighttime examples. In Acts 16:25–26, after Paul and Silas are imprisoned in Philippi, God’s Word notably mentions the timing of their worship: “About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God . . .” Silas and Paul don’t try to go to sleep early so they can engage with God at the crack of dawn. They stay up late, worshiping at midnight. The results are profound. In Psalm 63:5–6, David prays to the Lord, “My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and my mouth will praise you with joyful lips, when I remember you upon my bed, and meditate on you in the watches of the night.” This psalm as a whole is arguably a nighttime prayer. David prays these lyrics to the Lord seemingly all while on his “bed,” singing midnight praises. Consider Jesus’s earthly life. On the fateful day before his crucifixion, when it comes to spending devoted time alone with his Father, Jesus prays passionately, in Gethsemane, at night (Matt. 26:36–56). There is no mention in the Gospels of Jesus rising early on this momentous day; it might have happened, but the recorded emphasis is Jesus’s spiritual devotion in the dark. Morning and evening aren’t

featured.summary_zh: 分享在苦难中坚守的信仰和家庭福音化的历程……为“2027年8000万民族福音化大圣会”的祷告和传道而设的两天共6场聚会加利利召命教会（主任牧师金浩胜）将于11月27日（周五）至28日（周六）邀请高英顺院长（大田祷告院·永川卫理公会教会执事）举办治愈传道奋兴会。本次布道会是为“2027年8000万民族福音化大布道会”而举行的祷告和传道活动的一部分。聚会将在两天内每天的上午11点、下午2点和晚上7点共举行6场。聚会以恢复信徒的信心和向当地居民传福音为重点，将安排分享在生活苦难中仍坚守信心的见证，并一同祷告。担任讲员的高永顺院长将主要分享她在家庭中经历的信仰冲突与考验、对家人的传福音以及祈祷与侍奉的历程。主办方表示，将通过高院长的人生经历，分享如何在苦难中坚守信仰。

featured.content:
고난 속 신앙과 가족 복음화의 여정 나눠… 이틀간 총 6회 집회 ‘2027 8천만 민족복음화대성회’ 위한 기도와 전도의 자리로 마련

갈릴리소명교회(담임 김호승 목사)가 오는 11월 27일(금)부터 28일(토)까지 고영순 원장(대전기도원·영천감리교회 권사)을 초청해 치유전도 부흥성회를 개최한다.

이번 성회는 ‘2027 8천만 민족복음화대성회’를 위한 기도와 전도의 일환으로 마련됐다. 집회는 양일간 매일 오전 11시, 오후 2시, 오후 7시 등 총 6회 진행된다. 성도들의 신앙 회복과 지역주민을 향한 복음 전도에 초점을 맞춰, 삶의 고난 속에서도 신앙을 지켜온 간증을 나누고 함께 기도하는 시간으로 꾸며진다.

강사로 나서는 고영순 원장은 가정에서 겪은 신앙적 갈등과 시련, 가족을 향한 전도, 기도와 섬김의 여정을 중심으로 간증할 예정이다. 주최 측은 고 원장의 삶을 통해 고난 속에서도 믿음을 지키는 자세와 이웃을 향한 사랑의 실천을 함께 돌아보는 자리가 될 것으로 기대하고 있다.

고 원장의 간증에는 남편의 반대 속에서도 신앙생활을 이어간 이야기와 담임목회자의 신장 이식 문제를 둘러싼 가족의 고민과 결단, 시어머니에게 복음을 전한 과정 등이 담겨 있다. 개인과 가정의 어려움 속에서도 기도로 신앙을 지켜온 이야기가 이번 성회의 주요 메시지로 전해질 예정이다.

특히 이번 집회는 간증을 듣는 데 그치지 않고 참석자들이 자신의 삶과 가정을 돌아보며, 질병과 상처로 어려움을 겪는 이웃을 위해 함께 기도하는 데 의미를 두고 있다. 교회에 출석하는 성도뿐 아니라 기독교 신앙에 관심이 있는 지역주민들도 초청한다.

갈릴리소명교회는 성회를 앞두고 교회 인근 주택가와 상가, 거리에서 안내 전단을 배포하며 지역주민들에게 집회 소식을 알렸다. 김호승 목사와 성도들은 주민들을 직접 만나 집회 참석을 권유하는 한편, 성회 준비를 위한 기도를 이어가고 있다.

이번 성회는 갈릴리소명교회와 YGM선교연합회가 주최하고, 사단법인 민족복음화운동본부가 주관한다. 지역교회의 전도와 기도가 한국교회의 회복과 민족복음화를 위한 연합으로 이어지기를 바라는 취지를 담았다.

갈릴리소명교회는 이번 성회를 통해 고난 가운데 있는 이들이 복음의 위로를 얻고, 성도들이 가족과 이웃을 향한 전도의 사명을 새롭게 되새기기를 기대하고 있다.

성회 관련 문의는 갈릴리소명교회 전화 070-7575-4578 또는 010-3311-3112로 하면 된다.

featured.content_zh:
分享在苦难中的信仰和家庭福音化的历程……为期两天的共6场聚会，旨在为“2027年8000万民族福音化大聚会”提供一个祷告和传道的场所。

加利利召命教会（主任牧师金浩胜）将于11月27日（周五）至28日（周六）邀请高英顺院长（大田祷告院·永川卫理公会教会执事）举办一场医治布道复兴大会。本次布道会是为“2027年8000万民族福音化大布道会”而举行的祷告和传福音活动的一部分。聚会将在两天内每天上午11点、下午2点和晚上7点共举行6场。聚会以恢复信徒的信仰和向当地居民传福音为重点，将安排分享在生活苦难中仍坚守信仰的见证，并一同祷告。

作为主讲人，高英顺院长将主要围绕她在家庭中经历的信仰冲突与考验、对家人的传道以及祈祷与侍奉的历程进行见证分享。主办方希望通过高院长的经历，与大家一同回顾在苦难中坚守信仰的态度以及对邻里践行爱的行为。高院长的见证包括她在丈夫的反对下仍坚持信仰生活的故事，围绕主任牧师肾脏移植问题的家庭的苦恼与抉择，以及向婆婆传福音的过程等。在个人和家庭遭遇困难的情况下，通过祷告坚守信仰的故事将成为本次聚会的主要信息。

特别值得一提的是，本次聚会不仅是听取见证，而且还让与会者反思自己的生活和家庭，并为那些因疾病和创伤而饱受煎熬的邻居们共同祈祷。不仅邀请参加教会的信徒，还邀请对基督教信仰感兴趣的当地居民。在圣会召开前夕，加利利召命教会向教会附近的居民区、商圈和街道分发了宣传单，向当地居民告知了圣会的消息。金浩胜牧师和信徒们亲自与居民见面，邀请他们参加聚会，同时也在为圣会的筹备工作不断祷告。本次圣会由加利利召命教会和YGM宣教联合会主办，由社团法人民族福音化运动本部承办。这次聚会的宗旨是希望地方教会的传道和祷告能够促成韩国教会的复兴和民族福音化的联合。

加利利召命教会希望通过本次布道会，让身处苦难中的人们得到福音的安慰，并让信徒们重新铭记向家人和邻里传福音的使命。如需咨询有关布道会的事宜，请致电加利利召命教会，电话号码为070-7575-4578或010-3311-3112。活动指南 - 活动名称：高英顺院长受邀举办的医治布道复兴大会 - 时间：2026年11月27日（周五）至28日（周六），每天上午11点、下午2点、晚上7点 - 地点：加利利召命教会 - 讲员：高英顺院长（大田祷告院·永川卫理公会执事） - 主办：加利利召命教会·YGM宣教联合会 - 承办：社团法人民族福音化运动本部 - 咨询电话：070-7575-4578 / 010-3311-3112

featured.summary_zh: 反思与悔改时代使命 唤醒全球宣教新篇章 提出福音神学的七大领域 基督教学术院（院长金英汉博士）第51届灵性学术论坛祈祷会暨论文发表会于11月20日下午在首尔瑞草区良才洞恩惠教会（主任牧师李在勋）的和平厅举行。在当天的论坛上，金英汉院长（崇实大学名誉教授）以“首尔WEA大会的成果与展望”为主题致开幕词，随后进行了演讲和评论。金英汉院长以“WEA首尔宣言的神学意义和宣教展望”为题发表讲话，他表示：“在西方去基督教化、后现代主义解构主义、宗教多元主义等严峻挑战的背景下，WEA第14届大会重申了福音派教会向全球传播耶稣基督福音的时代使命。”他提出了以下几点意义：△反思未能履行时代使命并悔改△为面向世界宣教的觉醒奠定基础△提出世界福音派神学倡议的七大核心领域等。

featured.content:
시대적 소명에 대한 반성·회개 세계 선교 향한 각성 전기 마련 복음주의 신학 7대 영역 제시

기독교학술원(원장 김영한 박사) 제51회 영성학술포럼 기도회 및 발표회가 지난 11월 20일 오후 서울 서초구 양재 온누리교회(담임 이재훈 목사) 화평홀에서 개최됐다.

이날 포럼에서는 ‘서울 WEA 총회 성과 및 전망’이라는 주제로 김영한 원장(숭실대 명예교수)의 개회사 후 발표와 논평이 이어졌다.

‘WEA 서울 선언의 신학적 의미와 선교적 전망’이라는 제목으로 김영한 원장은 “서구의 탈기독교화, 포스트모더니즘 해체주의, 종교다원주의 등의 거센 도전 가운데, WEA 14차 총회는 지구촌에 예수 그리스도의 복음을 전파하는 복음주의 교회의 시대적 사명을 재확인했다”며 △시대적 소명 다하지 못함 반성과 회개 △세계 선교를 향한 각성 전기 마련 △세계 복음주의 신학 이니셔티브 7대 핵심 영역 등을 의의로 제시했다.

구체적으로는 “WEA 서울선언문은 살아있는 정통(Orthodox), 개혁적 보수(Conservative), 순전한 복음(Evangelical)을 확인한 선언이었다”며 “1846년 창립된 복음주의 신앙이 180년 지난 2026년 오늘날에도 325년 니케아 신조의 정통신앙을 그대로 계승하고 있음을 확인했다. 복음주의 신앙은 구약의 율법과 예언, 신약의 예수 그리스도, 사도, 초대교회 사도적 신앙, 종교개혁, 청교도 신앙을 계승하는 신앙”이라고 설명했다.

김영한 원장은 “성경무오와 그리스도 구원 복음 유일성, 말씀에 입각한 성령의 지속적 사역을 분명히 선언함으로써, 성경 비평을 수용하는 신복음주의적 타협이자 신사도운동으로 이탈, 정통 개혁신학으로부터의 이탈이라는 비난을 해소하고 정통 복음주의 신앙을 확고히 선언했다”며 “오늘날 복음주의는 특정 정치 이념(극우나 극좌)에 편승하지 않고, 예수 그리스도의 복음을 미종족들에게 전하며, 기후변화가 초래한 생태계 파괴와 위기에 대처하고, 첨단 AI 기술이 초래한 인간의 자기초월, 트랜스휴머니즘(transhuman), 인간 신(homo Deus)이 되려는 제2의 반역(The Second Revolt)을 경고하는 예언자적 사명을 감당해야 한다”고 밝혔다.

김 원장은 “WEA는 초월인간은 과학기술과 의학의 발전으로 부상하는 세속적 무신론(secular atheism)의 극대화된 방식이라고 폭로해야 한다”며 “오늘날 인류에게 유일한 소망은 다가오는 하나님의 왕국이다. 그러므로 예수 그리스도의 재림의 복음을 전파해야 한다”고 강조했다.

무오한 하나님의 말씀인 성경

이후 ‘세계복음주의연맹 서울 선언의 의의와 의미’를 제목으로 이승구 박사(합신대 석좌교수)는 “복음주의는 항상 성경이라는 객관적 기준과 성령님의 역사하심이라는 주관적 기준을 가지고 활동해 왔다. 성경에 철저히 따르지 않으면 복음주의가 아니고, 성령님께 온전히 순종하지 않는 것도 복음주의가 아니다”며 “‘서울 선언’은 성경의 무오성을 천명했다. 19세기부터 20세기 초까지는 ‘무류(infallible)’가 ‘무오(inerrant)’와 혼용됐다. 거의 같은 의미로 사용했기 때문”이라고 설명했다.

이승구 박사는 “그러나 1960년대 일부 신복음주의자들이 ‘무오’를 쓰지 않기 위해 ‘무류’를 들고 나왔다. 성경의 중심 교리는 틀림이 없으나, 인간 저자들의 지명 사용이나 연대, 그리고 과학적 언급에 있어 오류가 있다는 주장을 하기 시작했다”며 “이런 주장에 반대해 복음주의자들은 ‘성경 무오성 협회(the International Council on Biblical Inerrancy)’로 모여 ‘성경 무오성에 대한 시카고 선언(1978)’을 발표한 것”이라고 전했다.

이 박사는 “이것이 WEA가 창설된 19세기나 20세기 초 정황과 다른 1960년대 이후의 정황”이라며 “서울 총회에서 이를 더 명확하게 표현해 WEA에 대한 오해가 생기지 않게 하자고 했을 때, 가장 먼저, 가장 쉽게 모든 분들이 동의한 것이 ‘성경은 무오한 하나님 말씀(the inerrant Word of God)’이라는 표현이었다. 이로써 1846년 WEA 창립 때 ‘무류’라는 표현이 사실 ‘무오’를 뜻함이 분명히 드러났다”고 밝혔다.

그는 “‘성경이 무오하다’는 것은 단순히 선언으로 끝나는 것이 아니라, 성경 무오성을 지키는 방식으로 논의하며, 그 무오한 말씀에 근거해 우리 생각을 변화시키고, 철저히 말씀의 가르침을 따라 나아가야 함을 뜻한다”며 “이는 성경의 성격에 대한 선언일 뿐 아니라, 우리 사고와 삶의 방식에서 성경에 철저히 복종하겠다는 선언이다. 동시에 지금도 살아 역사하시는 성령을 인정하며, 성령께서 말씀(cum verbo)을 사용해 은혜를 베푸시고 우리를 변화시키심에 온전히 순종하겠다는 선언”이라고 정리했다.

WEA 서울총회의 공헌과 전망

이어 ‘WEA 서울총회의 공헌과 전망’이라는 제목으로 최형근 박사(서울신대)가 발표했다. 그는 “2025년 WEA 제14차 총회는 2024년 제4차 로잔대회와 더불어 불변하는 성경적 복음의 정수와 교회가 받은 대위임령의 과업을 재발견하고 확증하는 중대한 전환점이 됐다”며 “이 양대 회의는 복음과 교회에 적대적인 세속주의, 종교다원주의와 혼합주의와 무신론 물결 가운데 불변하는 성경 계시에 기반해 변화하는 문화적 환경에 적절하게 대처하는 복음주의 교회의 헌신과 행동에의 요청을 확고하게 드러냈다”고 말했다.

최형근 박사는 “14차 WEA 서울총회와 4차 로잔대회의 주제 성구, 공식 주제, 그리고 슬로건을 통해 살펴본 양대 복음주의 운동의 신학적 방향은 삼위일체 중심, 성경 중심, 그리스도 중심, 그리고 대위임령 중심이라는 공유된 교리와 교회의 실천으로 압축된다”며 “‘7대 신앙고백’에 근거해 작성된 WEA 서울선언문은 7장, 40개 문단으로 구성된 짧은 문서 형태다. 총회 조직위원회는 ‘서울 선언’을 기독교 핵심 교리와 행동에의 요청으로 명확하게 상술했다.

최 박사는 “WEA 서울총회의 공헌 중 하나는 한국 복음주의 신학의 위상을 전 세계에 알린 것으로, 한국 복음주의 신학자 10명이 WEA 선언문 작성위원회와 함께 협력해 선언문 작성에 참여했다. 이는 한국교회와 한국 신학의 발전과 위상을 전 세계에 보여준 중요한 전기”라며 “서울선언에 기독교 교리에 대한 강조점이 제시돼야 하는 것은 사실이지만, 선교에 대한 광범위한 이슈와 도전 과제를 다루기 위해 선교학자(그리고 여성 신학자들)의 참여와 한국로잔위원회 등과의 협력도 이뤄졌어야 했다”고 지적했다.

그는 “앞으로 세계 복음주의 양대 축인 WEA와 로잔운동이 교회와 선교의 분리 없는 통합과 협력을 촉진, 예수 그리스도의 대위임령을 효과적으로 협력하는 장을 마련해 나갈 수 있을 것”이라며 “두 대회는 남북한 복음적 평화통일의 동력을 제공하고, 북한 인권과 종교 탄압 실상을 전 세계 교회에 알리며, 세계 교회와 함께 북한 선교를 위해 기도하고, 열방의 평화를 위해 협력하는 장을 마련했다”고 평가했다.

논평에서 백석대 석좌교수 이상규 박사(고신대 명예교수)는 “WEA 총회 1년이 지난 시점에서 이를 결산하는 뜻깊은 학술모임을 갖게 됐다”며 “WEA가 그간 보여온 에큐메니칼 대화 행보와 지도부의 신사도운동 논란 등을 감안해, ‘서울 선언’에서 표명한 바를 성실하게 실행하는 노력이 필요하다”고 전했다.

바이어하우스학회 회장 이동주 박사(아신대)도 “오늘날 WCC와 같이 세속 이데올로기와 이방 종교들의 영향을 받아 우리 신앙과 구원의 근거를 져버리고, 성경이 ‘무류’한 하나님 말씀이라 고백하고 그 말씀이 성령의 역사로 인해 체험되고 실현되는 사실임을 부정하며, 영혼 구원과 속죄의 유일하고 독특한 하나님과 그 은혜를 무시하는 사람이나 기관은 결코 복음주의라고 할 수 없다”며 “순전한 복음(성경)과 창조주 하나님 자신의 영이신 성령이 우리 믿음과 삶과 윤리와 영혼 구원의 유일한 길이고, 이렇게 성령을 따라 행하는 사람이나 기관을 비복음적이라고 평할 수 없다”고 말했다.

反思时代使命、悔改、为世界宣教觉醒、奠定基础、提出福音主义神学的七大领域

11月20日下午，基督教学术院（院长金英汉博士）在首尔瑞草区良才洞恩惠教会（主任牧师李在勋）的和平厅举办了第51届灵性学术论坛的祈祷会和论文发表会。在当天的论坛上，在金英汉院长（崇实大学名誉教授）以“首尔WEA大会的成果与展望”为主题致开幕词后，进行了演讲和评论。

金英汉院长以“WEA首尔宣言的神学意义和宣教展望”为题，表示：“在西方去基督教化、后现代主义解构主义、宗教多元主义等严峻挑战的背景下，WEA第14届大会重申了福音派教会在全球传播耶稣基督福音的时代使命。”他提出了以下几点意义：△反思未能完成时代使命并悔改△为面向全球宣教的觉醒奠定基础△全球福音派神学倡议的七大核心领域。

具体而言，他表示：“WEA《首尔宣言》是一份确认了活的正统（Orthodox）、改革派保守主义（Conservative）和纯正福音主义（Evangelical）的宣言。”他还表示：“我们确认，1846年创立的福音主义信仰在180年后的今天，即2026年，仍然完整地传承着325年《尼西亚信经》的正统信仰。福音派信仰是一种继承了旧约的律法和预言、新约的耶稣基督、使徒、初代教会的使徒信仰、宗教改革以及清教徒信仰的信仰。”

金英汉院长表示：“通过明确宣告圣经无误、基督救恩福音的唯一性以及基于圣言的圣灵持续工作，我们消除了关于接受圣经批评的新福音主义妥协、偏离新使徒运动以及偏离正统改革神学的指责，并坚定地宣告了正统福音主义信仰。”他还表示：“当今的福音主义不应附和特定的政治意识形态（极右或极左），而是要向未受福音影响的族群传扬耶稣基督的福音，应对气候变化所导致的生态系统破坏和危机，并履行先知的使命，警告人们要警惕由先进人工智能技术所引发的人类自我超越、超人类主义（transhumanism）以及试图成为“人类之神”（homo Deus）的第二次叛乱（The Second Revolt）。”

金院长表示：“WEA应当揭露，超人主义是随着科技和医学的发展而兴起的世俗无神论（secular atheism）的极致表现。”他还强调：“当今人类唯一的希望就是即将到来的神的国度。因此，我们必须传播耶稣基督再临的福音。” 圣经是无谬误的神的话语

随后，以“世界福音联盟首尔宣言的意义和含义”为题，李承九博士（联合神学大学讲座教授）表示：“福音主义一直以圣经这一客观标准和圣灵的工作这一主观标准开展活动。如果不完全遵从圣经，就不是福音主义；如果不完全顺服圣灵，也不是福音主义。”他还表示：“《首尔宣言》宣告了圣经的无误性。

从19世纪到20世纪初，“无谬（infallible）”与“无误（inerrant）”混用。这是因为这两个词几乎被用于表达相同的含义。” 李承九博士表示：“然而，在20世纪60年代，一些新福音派为了避免使用‘无误’一词，而提出了‘无谬’一词。他们开始主张，圣经的核心教义是无可挑剔的，但在人类作者对地名的使用、年代以及科学论述方面存在谬误。”他还表示：“为了反对这种主张，福音派人士成立了‘圣经无谬性国际委员会’（the International Council on Biblical Inerrancy），并发表了‘关于圣经无谬性的芝加哥宣言’（1978年）。”

李博士表示：“这是1960年代以后的情况，与WEA成立时的19世纪或20世纪初的情况不同。”他还表示：“在首尔大会上，当大家提出要更明确地表达这一点，以避免对WEA产生误解时，大家最先、最容易达成一致的表述就是‘圣经是无谬误的神的话语（the inerrant Word of God）’。这清楚地表明，1846年WEA成立时使用的“无谬”一词实际上是指‘无误’。”

他说：“‘圣经无误’不仅仅是一句宣告，而是意味着我们要以维护圣经无误的方式进行讨论，根据这无误的话语改变我们的思想，并彻底遵从话语的教导。”“这不仅是对圣经性质的宣告，也是宣告我们在思想和生活方式上要彻底顺服圣经。同时，这也是对如今仍活在世上并作工的圣灵的承认，是对圣灵使用话语（cum verbo）赐予恩典并改变我们这一事实的完全顺服的宣告。” WEA首尔大会的贡献与展望

接下来，崔亨根博士（首尔神学大学）以“WEA首尔大会的贡献与展望”为题进行了发言。

他说：“2025年WEA第14届大会与2024年第4届洛桑大会一起，成为重新发现和确认圣经福音不变的精髓以及教会所领受的大使命的重大转折点。”他还表示：“这两次大会坚定地彰显了福音派教会的委身和行动的呼召，即在世俗主义、宗教多元主义、混合主义和无神论浪潮的冲击下，基于不变的圣经启示，适当地应对不断变化的文化环境，这些浪潮对福音和教会都抱有敌意。”

崔亨根博士表示：“通过第十四届WEA首尔大会和第四届洛桑大会的主题经文、官方主题和口号来审视两大福音派运动的神学方向，被浓缩为以三位一体为中心、以圣经为中心、以基督为中心、以大使命为中心的共同教义和教会实践。”他补充道，“根据‘七大信仰告白’撰写的WEA首尔宣言是一份简短的文件，由7章40段组成。大会组委会明确地将‘首尔宣言’作为对基督教核心教义和行动的呼吁。崔博士说，‘WEA首尔大会的贡献之一就是向世界提升了韩国福音派神学的地位，10位韩国福音派神学家参与了这次宣讲。与 WEA 宣言撰写委员会合作撰写宣言。

他说：“这是一个重要的转折点，向世界展示了韩国教会和韩国神学的发展和地位。” “首尔宣言确实应该强调基督教教义，但为了应对宣教中的广泛问题和挑战，应该有传教士（和女性神学家）的参与以及与韩国洛桑委员会的合作等。”他指出，“未来，世界福音派和洛桑运动这两个世界福音派主轴将推动教会与宣教机构的紧密结合与合作，履行耶稣基督的伟大使命。” “我们将能够提供有效合作的场所，”他说。 “这两次会议为朝鲜和韩国的福音派和平统一提供了动力，向世界各地的教会通报了朝鲜的人权和宗教压迫，与世界各地的教会一起为朝鲜的宣教祈祷，并为所有国家的和平合作提供了场所。”

featured.title_zh: 在刚果民主共和国被伊斯兰恐怖组织绑架的基督徒女性4年后获救
featured.content:
콩고민주공화국 동부에서 이슬람국가(IS)와 연계된 무장단체에 납치돼 4년 넘게 억류됐던 기독교 여성이 우간다군에 의해 구출됐다. 그는 억류 기간 성폭력을 당하고 이슬람으로 개종하도록 강요받았지만, 내면의 신앙을 지켰다고 증언했다.

크리스천데일리인터내셔널(CDI)에 따르면, 국제기독교박해감시단체(ICC)는 최근 발표한 보고서에서 “2022년 7월 콩고민주공화국 동부 루메(Lume) 마을에서 납치된 카퉁구 음바카 다르케(Katungu Mbaka Darke)가 이투리주에서 우간다 인민방위군에 의해 구출됐다”고 밝혔다.

당시 오후 9시께 연합민주군(ADF) 대원들이 마을을 공격했고, 다르케는 이 과정에서 납치됐다. ADF는 콩고민주공화국 동부에서 활동하는 무장단체로, 이슬람국가(IS)와 연계돼 있다.

다르케는 억류 기간 성폭력과 종교적 강압을 겪었다. 그는 ICC에 전한 증언에서 “납치됐을 때 저는 아직 어렸다. 그들 중 한 명이 저에게 성관계를 강요했다. 이슬람을 받아들이고 꾸란 구절을 외우도록 강요하기도 했다. 겉으로는 받아들였지만 마음속으로는 예수님이 하나님이라는 사실을 알고 있었다”고 밝혔다.

그는 억류 기간 ADF 대원과의 사이에서 두 자녀를 낳은 것으로 전해졌다. 오랜 기간 가족과 떨어져 지낸 그의 귀환은 실종 이후 생사를 알지 못했던 가족과 마을 주민들에게 큰 감격을 안겼다.

루메 마을 책임자 킴비 초보는 “가족들이 그녀를 다시 만날 수 없을 것이라고 생각할 정도로 오랜 시간 고통을 겪었다”고 전했다. 가족과 주민들은 그의 생사를 알 수 없는 상황에서 장례 의식까지 치렀던 것으로 알려졌다.

초보는 “그가 살아서 돌아온 것은 가족과 공동체 전체에 깊은 감동을 주는 일”이라며 “오랜 세월이 지난 뒤 살아 돌아온 것에 하나님께 감사한다”고 말했다.

르웬조리 지역 책임자 카세레카 마파티 자페트도 이번 납치를 규탄하며 “무장단체의 민간인 납치는 용납할 수 없는 행위”라고 밝혔다. 무투왕가 지역 교회 지도자들도 “다르케의 귀환을 환영한다”며 “여전히 무장단체에 억류돼 있는 다른 사람들을 잊지 말아야 한다”고 강조했다.

국제앰네스티는 2026년 5월 발표한 보고서에서 ADF가 민간인을 대상으로 살해와 납치, 강제노동, 아동 모집, 여성과 소녀에 대한 성폭력을 자행했다고 밝혔다.

유엔 인권최고대표사무소도 지난 10월 유엔 인권이사회에 제출한 보고서에서 2026년 1월 1일부터 9월 15일까지 ADF와 관련된 인권침해 319건을 확인했으며, 피해자는 1,500명 이상이라고 밝혔다.

다르케의 구출은 장기간 실종 상태였던 한 기독교 여성이 가족과 공동체로 돌아왔다는 점에서 의미가 있다. 그러나 동부 콩고에서는 여전히 무장단체의 공격과 납치로 가족과 떨어져 지내는 주민들이 남아 있다. ICC는 다르케의 회복과 함께 아직 억류된 사람들의 안전과 귀환을 위해 기도해 줄 것을 요청했다.

一名基督教女性在刚果民主共和国东部被与伊斯兰国（IS）有关联的武装组织绑架并关押了4年多，后被乌干达军队解救。她作证说，在被关押期间，她曾遭受性暴力，并被强迫皈依伊斯兰教，但她坚守了内心的信仰。据《基督教日报国际版》（CDI）报道，国际基督教迫害监测组织（ICC）在最近发布的一份报告中表示：“2022年7月在刚果民主共和国东部卢梅村被绑架的卡通古·姆巴卡·达尔克（Katungu Mbaka Darke）在伊图里省被乌干达人民国防军（UPDF）解救。” 当时，在晚上9点左右，民主同盟军（ADF）的成员袭击了该村庄，达尔克在这一过程中被绑架。ADF是一个在刚果民主共和国东部活动的武装组织，与伊斯兰国（IS）有联系。

达尔克在被拘禁期间遭受了性暴力和宗教胁迫。他在向国际刑事法院（ICC）作证时表示：“我被绑架时还很小。他们中的一个人强迫我发生性关系。他们还强迫我皈依伊斯兰教，背诵古兰经的经文。表面上我接受了，但心里知道耶稣就是神。” 据称，她在被拘禁期间与一名ADF成员生下了两个孩子。她长期与家人分离后终于归来，令自她失踪后一直不知其生死下落的家人和村民深受感动。鲁梅村负责人金比·乔博（Kimbi Chobo）表示：“她的家人承受了很长时间的痛苦，以至于他们以为再也见不到她了。” 据了解，在无法得知她生死的情况下，家人和村民甚至为她举行了葬礼。

楚波表示：“他活着回来，对他的家人和整个社区来说都是一件令人深受感动的事情。”他还说：“感谢上帝，在这么多年之后，他还能活着回来。” 鲁文佐里地区负责人卡塞雷卡·马帕蒂·扎佩特（Kasereka Mapati Japhet）也谴责了此次绑架事件，并表示“武装团体绑架平民是不可容忍的行为”。穆图旺加地区的教会领袖们也表示：“我们欢迎达尔克归来”，并强调：“我们不应忘记那些仍被武装组织关押的人。” 国际特赦组织在2026年5月发布的一份报告中指出，ADF对平民实施了杀害、绑架、强迫劳动、招募儿童兵以及对妇女和女童的性暴力。

联合国人权事务高级专员办事处在去年10月提交给联合国人权理事会的报告中也指出，2026年1月1日至9月15日期间，共确认了319起与ADF有关的侵犯人权事件，受害者超过1500人。达尔克的获救具有重要意义，因为这名长期失踪的基督徒女性得以重返家人和社区。然而，在刚果东部，仍有居民因武装团体的袭击和绑架而与家人分离。ICC呼吁大家为达尔克的康复以及仍被关押的人的安全和回归祈祷。

featured.summary: Presunto delincuente, herido en el abdomen Un hombre resultó herido de un disparo en el abdomen durante un procedimiento policial realizado este mediodía en Villa Santillán. Según pudo reconstruir LA
featured.content: Presunto delincuente, herido en el abdomen Un hombre resultó herido de un disparo en el abdomen durante un procedimiento policial realizado este mediodía en Villa Santillán. Según pudo reconstruir LA ARENA,luego de que efectivos policiales fueran alertados por vecinos sobre la presencia de una persona que saltaba por los techos e ingresaba a los patios de distintas viviendas, se produjo una persecución, y ante reiteradas voces de alto de los efectivos que lo perseguían, el sospechoso habría sacado algo de su cintura, por lo que uno de los policías le disparó. A pesar de la herida, el hombre siguió la marcha y se escondió en su propia casa. A los pocos minutos, el personal policial llegó a detenerlo y algunos familiares intentaron impedirlo. Finalmente, el herido fue asistido por una ambulancia del SEM, y fue trasladado al Hospital Favaloro, donde quedó internado, fuera de peligro. Llamados al 101. Según pudo saber este diario, alrededor de las 11.30 comenzaron a recibirse llamados al servicio de emergencias 101. Algunos vecinos señalaron que el sospechoso era un hombre conocido en el ambiente delictivo, residente del mismo barrio. De acuerdo con los testimonios recogidos, también habría ingresado a patios de viviendas y sería habitual que circule armado, ya sea con arma de fuego o con armas blancas.Cuando llegó el personal policial, los efectivos comenzaron a recorrer el sector y buscar al sospechoso por los patios y los techos, hasta que finalmente lo encontraron en la vía pública. En ese momento, le dieron reiteradas voces de alto, le ordenaron que se detuviera y se arrojara al suelo. Sin embargo, siempre de acuerdo con la reconstrucción preliminar del episodio, el hombre habría desobedecido las indicaciones y amenazado a los policías con dispararles. Los efectivos advirtieron que llevaba un objeto en la cintura que parecía ser un arma de fuego. Amenaza. En medio de la persecución, el hombre habría llevado la mano hacia ese objeto y, ante lo que interpretó como una amenaza inminente, uno de los policías efectuó un disparo con su arma reglamentaria, que impactó en el abdomen del sospechoso. A pesar de la herida, el hombre continuó corriendo hasta ingresar a su vivienda.Una vez en el lugar, se convocó a una ambulancia. Sin embargo, familiares del herido habrían impedido inicialmente que el personal policial lo asistiera. Finalmente, fue trasladado al Hospital Favaloro, donde recibió atención médica. La lesión no requirió una intervención quirúrgica y, según la información conocida por este diario, se encuentra fuera de peligro. Investigación en marcha. Tras el episodio se desplegaron las actuaciones correspondientes, con peritajes y distintas medidas para reconstruir las circunstancias en las que se produjo el disparo. La investigación se encuentra en manos del Ministerio Público Fiscal, representado por Cristian Casais y Selva Paggi. También tomó intervención la Fiscalía de Investigaciones Administrativas, dado que se trata de un hecho en el que un efectivo policial utilizó su arma reglamentaria. Versión policial. El Ministerio de Seguridad y Justicia y la Jefatura de Policía emitieron un comunicado conjunto informando sobre el incidente. Afirmaron que la intervención inició a raíz de reiterados llamados al 101, por la presencia de una persona que caminaba por los techos. “Quienes realizaron los avisos también aportaron referencias sobre posibles antecedentes de conductas violentas del individuo”, dijeron. Agregaron que continúan desarrollándose las diligencias para esclarecer las circunstancias en que se produjo el incidente. Respecto al efectivo policial que habría realizado el disparo, señalaron que “recibió acompañamiento de personal especializado para el seguimiento psicosocial correspondiente. Asimismo, se iniciaron las actuaciones administrativas pertinentes, con intervención de la Fiscalía de Investigaciones Administrativas”. Por último, confirmaron que el herido recibió atención médica en el Hospital Favaloro. Artícu

featured.title_zh: 探索犹太血统，应对反犹太主义
featured.content: By Charles Gardner — Charles and Linda on their wedding day My wife Linda had no idea of the Jewish background of her employers during the 1970s and 80s. She just knew that she loved working for them and only left to follow God’s call to work with children. So we travelled down to London for an exhibition of the Salmon and Gluckstein dynasty, and the story of how these resilient Jewish families fled violent persecution in Eastern Europe to build what became the largest catering company in the world known as J Lyons & Co. Linda worked there as a home economist from 1977-1984 but it was only much later that she learnt of the Jewish nature of the firm that once literally fed Britain with its teashops and corner houses on every high street, and its products in every home, Linda playing her part through her cooking and marketing skills. A few years later, after graduating from Bible College in Bournemouth, she worked at a prayer and reconciliation centre in Northern Ireland where she was introduced to the importance of the Christian faith’s Jewish roots, as a result of which she took a study tour of Israel to learn more. And on a second trip to the Holy Land ten years later, she got more than she bargained for. At Cana in Galilee, where Jesus turned water into wine at a wedding, Linda was given a vision of her own wedding. And we met on a blind date six months later! Though having Jewish ancestry myself, I grew up knowing nothing about it. But I learnt more later, especially after becoming a Christian in my early twenties, as Linda had done. It helped that I had a Jewish believer as my early mentor, and I became increasingly aware of the significance of our Jewish heritage, about which I now write prolifically. Meanwhile Linda, who has been teaching Christianity in Doncaster area schools for over 30 years, also now teaches about Judaism as it forms the context into which Christ came to us, fulfilling all the laws and promises of the Old Testament. So in both our cases, we were kept in the dark about very important aspects of our lives – until the Lord shone his light on the truth. Which brings me to the Christian Church as a whole, especially in the UK. We have known very little, if anything, of our faith’s Jewish roots or of God’s ongoing purposes for Israel. This needs to change – and fast! For we are surely hurtling towards the Messiah’s Second Coming like a high-speed train, in danger of coming off the rails with the rest of humanity if we fail to get to grips with how we Christians fit into the unfolding picture of global opposition to tiny Israel. What is our role as we watch antisemitism spread across the globe like wildfire? Do we just sit and watch, or write it off as having nothing to do with us, and remain silent? Or do we stand up to be counted as those who refuse to salute the new Nazism that portrays itself as anti-Zionism – a Confessing Church walking the way of the cross for God’s chosen people? My questions come as renewed calls are made for an independent inquiry into antisemitism at the BBC following news that Oscar-winning producer Lucie Kon has won £400,000 in compensation from the broadcaster. Lucie’s career is said to have unravelled after she raised concerns about antisemitism within the BBC, though the latter have not admitted to any fault. This is highly significant as millions of UK Christians are (where Israel is concerned) probably more influenced by what they hear from our national broadcaster than what they read in the Bible. featured.content_zh:
由查尔斯·加德纳(Charles Gardner)——查尔斯和琳达在他们的婚礼当天 我的妻子琳达对1970年代和80年代雇主的犹太背景一无所知. 她只知道她喜欢为他们工作,只好听从上帝的号召,与孩子们一起工作。

于是我们来到伦敦,为沙门王朝和格勒克斯泰因王朝举办展览, 讲述了这些坚韧的犹太家庭是如何逃离东欧的暴力迫害, 来建造一个被称为J Lyons & Co的世界最大的餐饮公司的故事。

琳达从1977年到1984年作为家庭经济学家在那里工作,但直到很晚,她才得知这家公司的犹太性质,曾经真正地向英国提供每条高街上的茶店和角楼,以及每家每户家中的产品,琳达通过她的烹饪和营销技巧扮演了她的角色.

几年后,她从伯恩茅斯的圣经学院毕业后,在北爱尔兰的一个祈祷与和解中心工作,在那里向她介绍了基督教信仰犹太教根源的重要性,因此她前往以色列学习更多知识. 在十年后的第二次圣地之行中,她得到了比她讨价还价的更多.

在加利利的卡纳,耶稣在婚礼上把水变成了葡萄酒,琳达得到了自己婚礼的愿景. 我们六个月后相识了! 虽然自己有犹太血统,但长大后却一无所知. 但我后来学到更多, 特别是在我20多岁时成为基督徒之后, 就像琳达所做的那样。

这有助于我有一个犹太教信徒作为我的早期导师,我越来越意识到我们的犹太遗产的重要性,我现在以正文写道。

Du 11 au 17 novembre, il retrouve le Pérou, pays auquel il est si profondément attaché et où il a passé de nombreuses années comme missionnaire, puis évêque de Chiclayo. C’est ici que Léon XIV, qui maîtrise déjà plusieurs langues, dont l’anglais, l’espagnol, l’italien et le français, aurait également appris le quechua, langue héritée de l’Empire inca. Dans un article publié par El País, un religieux augustin espagnol affirme que Robert Prevost a appris cette langue lors de son séjour missionnaire. Le cardinal Joseph Tobin, archevêque de Newark, a également confié à CNN que le nouveau Pape en avait acquis quelques rudiments. 在被评估为适合出行后，利奥十四世教宗正准备前往拉丁美洲进行牧灵访问。11月11日至17日，他将重返秘鲁，这是他深爱着的国家，他曾在这里度过了许多年，先是作为传教士，后来成为奇克拉约主教。

利奥十四世已经掌握了多种语言，包括英语、西班牙语、意大利语和法语，据称他正是在这里学习了印加帝国传承下来的语言——克丘亚语。虽然自就任教宗以来，他从未在公开场合使用过这种语言，但多方证词证实他曾学习过这种语言。是否意味着我们很快就能听到他用一种新语言讲话？

在《国家报》发表的一篇文章中，一位西班牙奥古斯丁会修士表示，罗伯特·普雷沃斯特在传教期间学习了这种语言。纽瓦克大主教、枢机主教约瑟夫·托宾（Joseph Tobin）也向美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）透露，新任教宗已掌握了一些基础知识。

featured.content: Cuando el 8 de mayo de 2025, el cardenal estadounidense Robert Prevost salió al balcón central de la Basílica de San Pedro convertido en el Papa León XIV era un desconocido para el gran público, incluso para muchos en Perú, donde pasó buena parte de su vida sacerdotal. Ese día, el periodista peruano Santiago Roncagliolo, quien admitió que hasta ese momento no tenía "ni la más remota idea" de quien era el nuevo jefe de la Iglesia católica, recibió el encargo de escribir un libro sobre él. "Lo único que sabía es que había sido misionero", confesó. No obstante, asumió la encomienda porque "consideraba que podía aportar algo diferente que un corresponsal en el Vaticano". "Si había una historia, yo podía contarla, por lo menos podría contar una parte que no están contando los grandes medios", agregó. El resultado es El pastor y los lobos, un libro fruto de más de un año de investigación. Para escribirlo, Roncagliolo recorrió las zonas de Perú donde Prevost desarrolló su labor pastoral y entrevistó a decenas de personas que lo conocieron. La obra se asemeja más a un thriller policial que a la biografía de un religioso, y está entrelazada con la propia infancia y juventud del autor. El escritor de El accidente, Y líbranos del mal y La pena máxima habló con BBC Mundo antes de su participación en el Hay Festival de Arequipa, que se celebró del 5 al 8 de noviembre, y a pocos días de que León XIV visite Perú desde este miércoles y hasta el 16 de noviembre. —Este libro contiene dos biografías al mismo tiempo, no solo la del Papa, sino también la suya. ¿Por qué decidió enfocar este trabajo así? —Bueno, tenía que explicar por qué el Papa existe. ¿Por qué es importante? ¿Por qué 1.400 millones de personas escuchan a alguien que no les cobra impuestos, que no tiene un ejército, que no tiene una autoridad directa? Y la única manera de explicarlo era acudiendo a mi propia experiencia, cuando yo era un niño con educación católica que sufría violencia dentro de su familia, que sufría violencia en el país y cómo esa fe se convirtió en un escudo contra el miedo, contra el dolor y en una fuente de sentido para un adolescente completamente perdido, como lo fui. La oferta de un padre, que es lo que ofrece la Iglesia católica, es muy atractiva para las personas que tuvimos relaciones violentas, difíciles con nuestros modelos paternos. —¿Por qué este Papa en particular? ¿Fue simplemente porque había sido misionero en Perú y luego obispo de Chiclayo? —En este caso me llamaba la atención que este Papa que se forma en Perú, en la teología de la liberación, tiene una aproximación al cristianismo como con la que yo había crecido. Una teoría que resalta que Dios, que Cristo no era un emperador ni un rico, sino que era el hijo de un carpintero, que fue perseguido por un imperio, que fue refugiado, fue torturado y finalmente asesinado. Más parecido a los guerrilleros que a los papas. En ese sentido, esta historia tenía que ver con lo que yo mismo había aprendido que era Dios y me parecía que había una historia, porque en países como España, donde vivo, mucha gente asocia a la Iglesia con el franquismo y yo más bien crecí con curas que eran bastante subversivos. Contar eso me parecía bastante interesante. —El pastor y los lobos deja una doble imagen de León XIV. Por un lado, la de un religioso que busca acercar la Iglesia a los fieles y que se preocupa por sus condiciones materiales. Por otro, la de una suerte de agente especial del Vaticano enviado para depurar la Iglesia de sacerdotes implicados en abusos, corrupción e incluso vínculos con sicarios. ¿Se esperaba esas dos facetas de este hombre? —No, mi principal preocupación era que podía no haber ninguna historia. Podía encontrarme con un sacerdote que se pasó todos los domingos dando homilías y que a lo mejor no había hecho nada en su vida y llegó a ser Papa por cuestiones burocráticas.
